subject: Cross-pod transition checklist and role boundaries
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Mills <sarah@compasshr.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20 09:12 -08:00
Subject: Cross-pod transition checklist and role boundaries

Team —

Per our leadership sync, I put together a first-pass checklist for the cross-pod transitions we need to run in Q1. The goal here is to minimize handoff risk when we move two feature teams to the new runtime pod model and to clarify owner boundaries for shared infra and observability.

High-level asks:
- Marcus: confirm technical ownership points and where we need SLO handoffs
- Aditya: sign off on any leadership-level exceptions (headcount bumps, interim reporting)
- Laura / Sarah: confirm HR communication cadence and 1:1 talking points for impacted ICs

Attached: cross-pod-transition-playbook-v1.pdf (checklist + timeline) and role_scope_matrix.xlsx (proposed owner matrix).

Key checklist excerpts:
1) Purpose & scope doc published to Notion (link in header)
2) Role boundary decisions (infra vs feature) with explicit matrix rows for KV cache, model upgrades, and rollout policies
3) 1:1 kit for managers (talking points, severance/relocation FAQ)
4) Transition timeline with canary windows and rollback triggers

Please review the attachment and reply with any redlines by EOW. If we have unresolved items, I want to loop in People Ops for guidance before finalizing coms.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Director, Platform Programs
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: cross-pod-transition-playbook-v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: role_scope_matrix.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sarah Mills <sarah@compasshr.com>
Date: 2026-12-20 11:03 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cross-pod transition checklist and role boundaries

Neha —

Thanks for pulling this together, looks thorough. Quick technical notes after a pass through the matrix:
- KV cache ownership: suggest we make runtime team (currently Pod Infra) responsible for cache lifecycle and TTL defaults; feature teams can request overrides via RFC with clear rollback plan.
- Model upgrades: infra owns rollout orchestration but feature leads must own regression test suites and prompt sets; add a callout in matrix.
- Observability: agree that per-route dashboards stay with the feature owner; infra provides baselines and SLO templates.

I added inline comments to the role_scope_matrix.xlsx (column H) and flagged two items that likely need a short-term escalation (trainer access for feature leads; canary traffic split tooling).

On timeline: Q1 week 4 feels tight for the second pod move given current backlog. Recommend adding a two-week buffer or moving the canary window earlier for incremental rollouts.

I'll coordinate with my leads on the regression test ownership and return with a revised timeline by Wednesday.

—Marcus
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

Subject: Re: Cross-pod transition checklist and role boundaries

Thanks — this is great work. A few leadership-level comments:

1) Headcount and reporting: I'm open to temporary dotted-line reporting for up to 3 engineers for 90 days during transition, but I want managers to avoid >6 direct reports during the canary window. If any manager expects +2 beyond that, they should provide a mitigation plan.
2) Compensation impact: we should make sure the comms explicitly say there are no involuntary changes to comp in these moves — HR will help shape this language.
3) Customer-facing SLAs: if the move touches any enterprise accounts, we need an explicit pre-migration notification and a fallback plan; ticket owners should be named in the playbook.

Approve the checklist to be shared with People Ops for comms prep, pending Marcus timeline update.

Aditya
VP, Product & Platform

Neha / team —

I've reviewed and added HR notes inline in the Notion doc and attached a short manager kit (1-page) with suggested talking points. Main HR considerations:
- Timing: avoid heavy comms during holiday week; recommend a staged announcement early Jan with manager 1:1s scheduled the same week.
- Career path framing: for any role boundary changes, provide a clear path to restore or expand scope within 6 months and include training budget.
- Severance/relocation: we should prepare templated language; Sarah from Compass HR has offered to draft the base templates.

Action items for me:
- Draft 1:1 script and FAQ by Friday, send to Neha for review
- Coordinate an optional manager training drop-in the week of Jan 4

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations

- Provide a clear escalation path and named HR contact in every manager script.
- Offer optional open office hours for impacted ICs during the first two weeks after announcement.

I'll send a draft of the announcement + FAQ by Thursday. If you want, I can also run a 30-minute rehearsal session with managers on Jan 5.

Best,
